objective.text: Isolate non-database temporary resources by test-process token rather than assuming database isolation covers files.

difficulty.rationale: Extend test isolation to a resource not isolated by database naming.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Parallel tests have separate test databases but all write exports/report.csv in the same filesystem. Intermittent overwrites occur. Which change addresses this non-database collision?

options.text: Add a database transaction around the CSV write.
options.rationale: A database transaction does not make a shared file path process-specific.
options.misconception: A database transaction does not make a shared file path process-specific.

options.text: Disable foreign-key checks in each test database.
options.rationale: Foreign-key enforcement is unrelated to two processes writing the same file.
options.misconception: Foreign-key enforcement is unrelated to two processes writing the same file.

options.text: Keep the shared path because the database suffix also applies to every file operation.
options.rationale: Laravel’s parallel database naming does not automatically rewrite custom file paths.
options.misconception: Laravel’s parallel database naming does not automatically rewrite custom file paths.

options.text: Include the parallel process token in each process’s export directory and clean up that directory.
options.rationale: A process-specific namespace separates file artifacts; separate database names do not isolate arbitrary filesystem paths.

explanation.summary: A process-specific namespace separates file artifacts; separate database names do not isolate arbitrary filesystem paths.
